newsitem.title: CHINA: Schuller to expand China venture by $30 mln.
newsitem.headline: Schuller to expand China venture by $30 mln.

text.p: U.S.-based Schuller Corp plans to invest an additional $30 million to expand its glass fibre joint venture in eastern China, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.
The investment would be used to boost the plant's output of glass fibre matting used for flooring and roofing, and to start production of other waterproof materials, the newspaper said.
The factory in Changzhou in Jiangsu province now produces 50 million square metres of glass fibre mat, it said but did not say what expanded output would be.

Schuller already has a 60 percent stake in the $30 million plant, while China National New Building Materials (Group) Corp and Tianma Group were the other partners, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
